capabilities: Run an agent loop that edits vault notes with approval and one-click undo
Search notes by meaning with a local vector index and reranker
Ingest PDFs and web pages into source notes with block-level provenance
Generate DOCX, XLSX and beta PPTX files from notes
Run vault health checks for orphans, broken links and weak clusters
disambiguation: Not a plain chatbot; it runs an agent loop that executes actions against the vault, with approval gates and checkpoints.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; PPTX generation is beta; full documentation lives at pssah4.github.io/vault-operator; the manifest carries the standard 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; local-first with no telemetry, but API keys fall back to plain settings where OS secure storage is unavailable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI that can act on the vault, and plain chatbots answer without reading, writing, or repairing your notes.

relations.evidence: Plugin-API discovery lets the agent invoke installed plugins (Excalidraw, Dataview, Tasks)

requires.name: model provider API key or OAuth (Google AI Studio, Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.)
ChatGPT, Claude Desktop or Perplexity as MCP clients
Brave or Tavily key for web search

summary: Agentic AI layer that plans and runs vault tasks, searching, reading, writing and reporting, with per-action approval, memory and undo.
